def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one plain file name: non-empty, no path separators, not '.' or '..'."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name:
        return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the `notes` directory. Returns "" when the file is missing or unreadable, or when name is not a plain file name. Reads through fs.sub("notes") so no name can reach a file outside notes."""
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(name) else ""
        return text
